Description
Avail Sept 1/26 Min 1 Year Term Unfurnished Pet Friendly Secure Underground Parking Storage Locker in Parking Space Professionally Managed by Hello Rent Charming 2 bed+den+2 bath Kitsilano unit on the 3rd floor offers the feel and convenience of ground-level living. Positioned above retail space, the home opens directly onto a large landscaped courtyard with your own private patio. Comfortable practical layout with 2 well-sized bedrooms, 2 full baths, flexible den ideal for a home office, plus a large entry flex room for storage, pantry or gear. Located on W Broadway above London Drugs, surrounded by cafés, shops, restaurants, groceries and transit. Easy access to Kits Beach, waterfront routes, Downtown and UBC. Tenant insurance required at move-in. $200 move-in fee paid to Strata BCS667.

Description
Elevate your lifestyle with this exceptional townhome situated in an exclusive, upscale neighbourhood. Immerse yourself in the serene beauty of an expansive rooftop deck, perfect for entertaining or simply savouring the picturesque vistas where breathtaking water, city, and mountain views await. Step into the private master suite offers a retreat-like ambiance with its spacious layout, walk-in closet, and lavish bathroom featuring a soaker tub and separate shower. Maple hardwood floors and stylish glass railings enhance the home's elegance, while the gourmet kitchen, equipped with high-end appliances, ensures a seamless culinary experience.

Ideally situated near top private and public schools, including Lord Byng Secondary School, St. George's School, and Crofton House School.
